recorded.rule: Q2 v2: a giveaway, read from the question's own text alone
recorded.prompt:q-extend-an-enum: Answer ONLY from this question's own text: its stem and its options. Use no knowledge of the subject at all; treat every term as a word you have never met. Pick an option only when the wording itself singles it out: it is longer or more specific than the others, it repeats words from the stem, the others carry absolute terms such as 'always' or 'never', the stem's grammar fits it alone, or it restates the stem. A cue decides only when it clearly singles out one option over every other; a weak cue, or one another option shares, decides nothing. Otherwise answer 'none'. Say which cue decided it, or that none did.
recorded.pass:q-extend-an-enum: an independent page-free reader (28-enhanced-enums q2), never the author
recorded.outcome:q-extend-an-enum: from the question's text alone, the reader picked none; the key is 'a'
recorded.because:q-extend-an-enum: a repeats 'enum(s)' from the stem and c repeats 'ExtendedSeverity'; each option echoes a different stem word and lengths are similar, so no cue singles one out.
